Why can’t I just tap the space on my page I want to write in, now I have to go to the top and click to “add text” then I have to click where I want it…why are we adding steps? reviews.title: I Would Recommend 10/10.. Could It Be Even Better? 😳
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years at this point, I love it! It’s one of the few subscriptions that always stays, because I love the cross compatibility with all my devices and the layouts are always **GORGEOUS**!

If there’s a better place to leave feedback I will happily edit my review, but one thing I wish we had was the ability to add new pages from the preset templates of the journal you’re in. Example: I’m in a planner journal and I want to add another notes page. Currently, I have to duplicate a page at the bottom of my journal and drag it up. Is there any way we could have the page templates that make up a journal, be part of the pages you can find and add when you “add a page”? This app has always held a soft spot, but so many times I’ve gone to “add a page” and been bummed I can’t pull from the preset pages of my journal, and have to drag a notes page from the end of a journal, or have to duplicate a page and erase the writing for a clean version (planner, book journal, other notebooks..)- is there anything that could be done? 🥹🥲

Sincerely,

Your Greatest Fan ☺️♥️

P.S. Keep up the great work. I adore you guys! 🥳😊

reviews.title: Mostly Great
reviews.text: I began using this app in 2026 and find it to be fairly straightforward and easy to use. I imported a PDF planner into Zinnia rather than create my own. I do use some of the graphics provided in the app, but find many to be incapable of resizing without losing part of the graphic. I sometimes need a very narrow text box, but most of the graphics only size by corner anchors with no option of side anchors to scale it up/down. The app is expensive in my opinion. I won’t be renewing my subscription for one major reason: there is NO search ability for any text I’ve added to my planner, which is a severe handicap when I need to find something quickly. A lot of info adds up within a yearly planner and trying to find something specific without a search option is difficult. The app should have this option, without question.
